facts.raw_span: A 34-year-old gravida 2, para 1 woman with a spontaneous dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancy
Dichorionicity had been confirmed on first-trimester ultrasound
early-onset growth restriction in twin 2
new-onset preeclampsia at 30 weeks
twin 2 had estimated fetal weight <5th percentile, anhydramnios, and an absent bladder
Tetralogy of Fallot in twin 2
amniotic fluid improved from anhydramnios to oligohydramnios (maximum vertical pocket 1.9 cm) in twin 2
normal chromosomal microarray in twin 2
twin 1: estimated fetal weight 1904 g (62nd centile), normal amniotic fluid, normal umbilical-artery Dopplers, and MCA-PSV 26 cm/s (0.56 multiples of the mean)
twin 2: estimated fetal weight 1128 g (<5th centile), normal amniotic fluid, normal umbilical-artery Dopplers, and MCA-PSV 50.9 cm/s (1.3 MoM)
thickened, echogenic placenta for twin 2
suspicion for twin anemia-polycythemia sequence
